items.context: @TwinTowerCity (53.949 seguidores), en inglés: "Bitcoin rebounded 11% to $61,034 from a $55,111 cycle low as stocks slid. Analysts disagree on whether the bottom is in." Pregunta abierta sobre si ya se tocó piso: ~1 h 45 min, 0 respuestas, 193 vistas. Cuenta mediana sin competencia de respuestas; se responde con precio realizado, media de 200 semanas y el índice Market Temperature.
items.suggested_text:
Two levels frame that debate better than the bounce itself. The $55,111 low came within about 3.5% of the realized price ($53,250 on Nov 22, per 21Shares), the average cost basis of coins last moved on-chain, while $BTC is still below its 200-week average near $68K. The deepest bear-market lows have historically printed around or below realized price, and reclaiming the 200-week line usually came much later.

The market temperature index I track, which blends MVRV, price vs. the 200-week average, drawdown from the high and 90-day momentum, went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122727211610542288

A reading that cold says most of the excess is gone. It says nothing about how long price decides to sit in the cold.
